bitget.html_report: generated before acceptance rejected incomplete input

bitget_root_cause.description: CCXT 4.5.89 Classic Futures history-candles pages are capped at 200 bars. The client requested 1000; CCXT derived a 1000-bar end window and then shortened the historical request to 200 without moving that end, skipping 800 bars on each page. The client also advanced its cursor by 1 ms, which does not preserve Bitget candle boundary alignment.
bitget_root_cause.worktree_remediation: Use a 200-bar page limit for Bitget and align each subsequent fixed-duration cursor to the next candle open. Add a regression test that verifies page size and aligned cursors.

limitations: The run predates the Bitget pagination fix and shared as-of cutoff implementation.
The Binance public profile was not tested because the hosted runner's region was rejected.
This evidence does not cover authenticated APIs, testnet/live orders, or exchange execution lifecycle.
